title: Trump licks wounds as Democrats celebrate huge midterms win

blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Donald Trump faced a radically transformed and hostile political landscape on Wednesday after US voters handed control of Congress to the Democrats in a stunning rebuke to his presidency. The result was a personal humiliation for the 80-year-old Trump as a Democratic wave swept into his Republican heartland, boosted by anger at soaring energy prices and his costly war with Iran. The Democratic capture of the Senate and House of Representatives signals an end to Trump’s stranglehold on US politics and gives Democrats the power to block legislation, launch probes into the administration and thwart his appointments.
